coverage_note: Packet contains only supplementary figure captions (S1-S4) for a prognostic senescence-related signature ML model in cervical cancer. All analyses are prediction, survival modeling, association, correlation, differential abundance, or enrichment. No design-level causal analysis (no named identifying variation, no formal directed-hypothesis method) is present, so no qualifying units; the five prognostic/association candidates are recorded as boundary items failing the causal-basis condition.

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Prognostic survival prediction of OS by the senescence signature in training and validation sets. This is prediction/survival modeling with no named identifying variation or formal directed-hypothesis method, so it fails the causal-basis condition.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: SRS risk score predicting overall survival (ROC/Kaplan-Meier prognostic model)

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: ROC-based prediction of metastasis by the risk signature. Classification/prediction with no named identifying variation or formal directed-hypothesis method.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: SRS predicting metastasis in cervical cancer

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Univariate/multivariate regression and nomogram construction for OS prediction. Regression/survival modeling of prognostic associations, no named causal design or formal directed method.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Univariate/multivariate analysis and nomogram of SRS with clinical characteristics

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Differential-abundance, correlation, and survival intersection of immune cell types across risk groups. Association/differential analysis only, with no identifying variation or formal directed-hypothesis method.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Immune microenvironment associated with SRS risk groups

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Comparison and correlation of predicted IC50 drug sensitivity with SRS risk scores. Correlation/prediction against imputed sensitivity, no controlled intervention or formal directed method; fails causal-basis condition.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Correlation between SRS and small-molecule drug sensitivity
